features.title: What you do in Late Winner

club.title: Take over a club
club.text: Pick one of {count} clubs in five countries, from a title favourite to a second-division side fighting to come back up.

lineup.title: Pick your line-up
lineup.text: {formations} formations, every player's rating in every position and the instruction your team starts with: attack, balanced or sit back.

live.title: Live matches with choices
live.text: Watch your match live and stop it whenever you like. A penalty, a free kick, a booked player losing their temper: you make the call, and your substitutions at the breaks.

market.title: The transfer market
market.text: The game spots your weak spot and suggests players you can afford. Sign, sell and keep your wage bill under its ceiling.

objectives.title: Season objectives
objectives.text: The board sets a league target and a cup target, and you choose a third. Meet them and your budget grows the next season.

promotion.title: Promotion and relegation
promotion.text: Each country has two divisions and a cup. Finish near the top to go up, near the bottom to go down, and the next season carries on.

screenshots.title: The game in pictures
screenshots.label: Screenshots of the game on a phone

lineup.alt: The line-up screen on a phone: the eleven on the pitch, each player with their rating in their position.

market.alt: The transfer market on a phone: the team's weak spot at centre back and a suggested player, with their ratings, price and wage.

challenge.title: The weekly challenge
challenge.text: Every Monday brings a new challenge: the same club for everyone and ten league matchdays to post the best score. Sign in with Google to appear in the ranking.

access.title: Free, no download, on your phone

free.title: Free
free.text: No purchase, no subscription, no advertising: the whole game is free.

browser.title: No download
browser.text: Nothing to install: the game runs in your browser, on a computer as on a phone.

phone.title: Made for phones
phone.text: Every screen fits a phone, live matches included.

free.question: Is Late Winner free?
free.answer: Yes. The whole game is free: no purchase, no subscription and no advertising.

account.question: Do I need an account?
account.answer: No. Start a career in one click: it is tied to your browser. Sign in with Google to find it on another device, run up to three careers and appear in the weekly challenge's ranking.

phone.question: Can I play on my phone?
phone.answer: Yes. The game runs in your phone's browser with nothing to install, and every screen is laid out for it.

languages.question: Which languages is it in?
languages.answer: English and French. Switch at the top of the page, or in your career's settings.

save.question: Where is my career saved?
save.answer: On the game's server. Without an account, it is tied to this browser and deleted if you do not come back for 30 days; with a Google account, it is kept as long as your account exists. A weekly challenge career is deleted on the Tuesday after its week.
